title: Pregnant Brittany Higgins shocks with 'break-up' post on Valentine's Day
text:
Brittany Higgins has joked that a sweet tribute to Valentine’s Day to her husband David Sharaz will be “redundant” if future parents break.
Mrs. Higgins, 30, shared a photo carousel of the couple at her June wedding, in the snow and walking her Kingston dog to her Instagram on Friday.
‘My always Valentine. *** Unless we break, so all this publication is redundant. I love you @davidsharaz X, ‘She sprouted in the subtitle.
Mrs. Higgins hopes to give birth to her first child, a baby, this month.
The former liberal political employee and her husband announced in July that they were waiting for their first child after a luxurious wedding at Gold Coast a month earlier.
In October, Mrs. Higgins shared a series of photos of her flourishing baby bulk when she admitted that the first half of her pregnancy had been “very stressful” after he recently received worrying news about his unborn baby.
The terrible experience was at the top of a recent defamation trial against her former boss, Liberal Senator Linda Reynolds and her grandmother’s recent death.
Higgins said the uncertainty in recent weeks had made her feel grateful for her unborn son.

“Fifteen days ago, David and I had the shock of our lives after the midwife told us in the middle of my second quarter that my blood analysis had raised some red flags,” Higgins wrote.
‘Our baby had a high probability of a genetic disorder, which would not have imported us, but in fear it could mean that it could be incompatible with life outside the uterus.
‘After an amniocentesis and an apparently endless wait, our prayers were answered. Our little boy is perfectly well and healthy.
“My mind cannot help returning to that waiting room in the hospital, full of pregnant women, who were having the same test as us and if they had been very fortunate.”
The Valentine’s Day Post occurs only a few days after the couple received a new blow for the sale of their French castle Bankrolled Bankrolled.
The house is expected to be sold with a massive loss with it still in the market six months after it went up for sale for the first time, even after the price was reduced last year.
The French real estate agent of Mrs. Higgins refuses to comment on the speculation that the price will be further reduced in the coming weeks in an attempt to prepare some interest.
The three bedroom mansion in moons, a small town 100 km east of Bordeaux in southwest France, has had ‘a couple of offers,’ the agent told Daily Mail Australia.

A year before moving to France, Mrs. Higgins received more than $ 2.4 million taxpayers’ funds for their loss of income capacity, legal costs, medical expenses, national assistance and $ 400,000 ‘for damages, anguish and humiliation’ .
The payment of the Albanese government was for its treatment in Canberra after its alleged violation of former colleague Bruce Lehrmann in Parliament in 2019.
